shell_commands: ls -la src/orchestration/tools/ && echo "---" && cat package.json | grep -A 20 '"dependencies"' | head -30
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 20 "Test Suites:"
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 20 "Test Suites:"

git add package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): add input schema validation to ToolRegistry.execute

Compile static schemas at register time and validate input against
inputSchema before executor runs. Invalid input returns a ToolResponse
with validation errors instead of invoking executor.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 5 "Test Suites:"

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "docs: add execute method doc comment pointing to spec

Update .lore/dod.md to mark validation and compilation facets as complete."
